title: Apple's new CEO is a product perfectionist taking on the AI age
title_zh: 苹果新任首席执行官是一位迎接人工智能时代的产品完美主义者
summary: To understand how Apple's new CEO John Ternus will run the company, pay attention to what he refuses to sell. "We never think about shipping a technology," Ternus, 50, said in a recent interview about AI ‌with tech review site Tom's Guide.
summary_zh: 要了解苹果新任首席执行官约翰·特努斯将如何管理公司，请注意他拒绝出售的东西。 “我们从来没有考虑过发布一项技术，”50 岁的 Ternus 在最近接受技术评论网站 Tom's Guide 采访时表示。

title: Everything we know about Apple's new CEO John Ternus
title_zh: 关于苹果新任首席执行官约翰·特努斯（John Ternus）我们所知道的一切
summary: John Ternus will become Apple's next CEO on Sept. 1. Here's what you need to know about him.
summary_zh: John Ternus 将于 9 月 1 日成为苹果公司的下一任首席执行官。以下是您需要了解的关于他的信息。

title: Apple CEO Tim Cook steps down: 7 big challenges for new CEO John Ternus
title_zh: 苹果CEO蒂姆·库克卸任：新任CEO约翰·特努斯面临7大挑战
summary: Apple's incoming new CEO John Ternus has a long list of to-dos early on.
summary_zh: 苹果即将上任的新任首席执行官约翰·特纳斯 (John Ternus) 很早就制定了一份长长的待办事项清单。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq futures inch up amid Apple CEO change and Iran uncertainty
title_zh: 今日股市：由于苹果首席执行官更换和伊朗不确定性，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货小幅上涨
summary: Major gauges eked out gains in a busy earnings season as Apple announces John Ternus for the top position.
summary_zh: 随着苹果公司宣布约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 担任首席执行官，主要指标在繁忙的财报季节中小幅上涨。

title: Tim Cook is stepping down as Apple's CEO. Investors are $4 trillion richer because of him.
title_zh: 蒂姆·库克将辞去苹果公司首席执行官一职。投资者因他而增加了 4 万亿美元。
summary: Tim Cook turned Apple into a $4 trillion behemoth during its 15 years as CEO.
summary_zh: 蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 在担任 CEO 的 15 年里将苹果公司打造成了价值 4 万亿美元的庞然大物。

title: Tesla settles wrongful death lawsuit over crash that killed Florida teenager
title_zh: 特斯拉就导致佛罗里达青少年死亡的事故达成和解
summary: Billionaire entrepreneur Elon Musk’s Tesla has settled a wrongful death lawsuit in Florida stemming from a 2018 high-speed crash that ‌killed a teenager riding in one of the electric vehicle maker's sedans, court records ‌show.
summary_zh: 法庭记录显示，亿万富翁企业家埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 旗下的特斯拉 (Tesla) 已在佛罗里达州解决了一起非正常死亡诉讼，该诉讼起因于 2018 年一场高速车祸，导致一名乘坐这家电动汽车制造商一辆轿车的青少年死亡。

title: Apple CEO Tim Cook to step down, John Ternus named successor
title_zh: 苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 辞职，约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 任命继任者
summary: Ross Gerber, Gerber Kawasaki Wealth & Investment Management comments on Tim Cook stepping down as Apple CEO on September 1, 2026, to become Executive Chairman, passing the torch to Hardware VP John Ternus to lead the company's next era of AI and innovation.
summary_zh: 罗斯·格伯 (Ross Gerber)、格伯川崎财富与投资管理公司 (Gerber Kawasaki Wealth & Investment Management) 评论蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 将于 2026 年 9 月 1 日辞去苹果首席执行官职务，出任执行董事...

title: How Tesla & Meta stocks are moving ahead of tech earnings
title_zh: 特斯拉和 Meta 股票如何领先于科技股盈利
summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre takes a look at Tesla's (TSLA) and Meta's (META) stock price action as we approach tech earnings.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 在我们接近科技公司财报之际关注了特斯拉 (TSLA) 和 Meta (META) 的股价走势。

title: Tesla is last in the 'Magnificent 7' rally — and the first tech giant to report earnings: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 特斯拉在“宏伟 7”涨势中排名最后，也是第一家公布收益的科技巨头：每日图表
summary: Since the broader market's March 30 low, Tesla is up only 11%, dead last among its "Magnificent Seven" tech peers.
summary_zh: 自 3 月 30 日大盘触及低点以来​​，特斯拉仅上涨了 11%，在“七巨头”科技同行中垫底。
